response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.order_count) AS avg_order_count, AVG(tc.order_count - overall.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE tc.order_count > overall.avg_count

assumptions.assumption: Orders with a NULL order type are excluded because NULL does not identify a type.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat NULL order type as its own group.
